claims: C1 in unclear cases the assistant should wait before interjecting
C2 the wait lasts until there is sufficient signal that danger is imminent
C3 the rule applies to situations where the video interjection rule also applies
C4 the rule carries root authority, so it outranks the video interjection rule's default to interject

concepts.name: unclear_case
concepts.gloss: S is a situation in which the danger is not yet clearly imminent but the video interjection rule would otherwise call for interjection
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of unclear cases where the video interjection rule applies; the situation must be one where that rule would otherwise trigger

concepts.name: danger_imminent
concepts.gloss: S is a situation in which there is sufficient signal that danger is imminent
concepts.inference: the clause's condition for ending the wait is that sufficient signal of imminent danger exists

concepts.name: applies_to
concepts.gloss: rule R applies to situation S
concepts.inference: the clause's directive concerns situations in which the interjection rule applies

concepts.name: unclear_cases_wait_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the rule that in unclear cases the assistant should wait until there is sufficient signal that danger is imminent before interjecting

concepts.name: video_interjection_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the rule that the assistant should interject when it identifies something on camera that could cause imminent bodily harm or death to the user
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the video interjection rule

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: interjecting in situation % is forbidden while the danger is not yet imminent, because the unclear-cases rule requires waiting for sufficient signal of imminent danger
asserts.body: unclear_cases_wait_rule(R), video_interjection_rule(V), root_authority(R), root_authority(V), applies_to(R, S), applies_to(V, S), danger_imminent(S)

closure.reason: the clause directs the assistant to wait in unclear cases, so interjecting before sufficient signal of imminent danger is prohibited
